title: Expired replay
description: What is left of a replay the retention sweep removed: `_expired/<id>.json`, and each item of `GET /api/expired-replays` (`{ days, records }`). It holds only what the index row showed, never the recording (no events, URL, comments or media), and is dropped `RETENTION_EXPIRED_DAYS` after the removal. Source of truth: src/shared/expired.ts.

capturedAt.description: When it was recorded (the producer's clock).

expiredAt.description: When the retention sweep removed it (the server's clock).

retentionDays.description: The retention window that applied, in whole days.

profile.description: Its profile, when it had one.
